node.title: KoalaBear Q6 u2 primitive-subdegree-four route cut
node.closure: primitive-group classification plus pole and Riemann-Hurwitz ledger
node.statement: After the proved line and conic exclusions, a residual actual KoalaBear Q=6,s=6,u=2 birational-quartic component would give subdegree four in the geometric monodromy of a degree-60 endpoint map. None of the nine primitive degree-60 groups has subdegree four, so the map is functionally decomposable. Exact pole and Riemann-Hurwitz constraints leave inner degrees {2,3,4,5,6,10,12,30}. This is a finite route cut, not a quotient owner, u2 close, cap 68, row payment, or endpoint movement.
